comment: The external clock jack has no family set, because the menu decides whether it wants a tempo voltage or a stream of clock pulses. The tempo knob is configured -2.0 to 2.32195 with a displayBase of 2 and a multiplier of 60, which is 15 to 300 BPM. The ON/OFF jack is read through a BooleanTrigger on `getVoltage() ? true : false`, so it has no threshold at all and flips on any departure from exactly 0V. The divider table has no /1 entry: index 11 is x1. This module is the maker's rework of ShaBang's Polyrhythm Clock.
